concerns.text: "No open dataset provides both WCST metrics and a nostalgia/control label. Therefore the plan implements a deterministic synthetic data generator that produces a fully compliant dataset..." This synthetic dataset does not constitute a real, appropriate data source for the research question, which requires empirical WCST performance under nostalgia vs. control conditions. Using simulated data cannot answer the primary hypothesis and violates FR‑001–FR‑006 which assume ingestion of real public data. A real dataset (or a revised question that can be answered with synthetic data) is required.
